entry.title: Percolator OUT 2.1.0
entry.summary: Plays one of Percolator's OUT 1-4 on its own MPC track (an audio track will do), so a voice gets that track's fader, inserts and outputs. ## What's new in 2.1.0 Released with Percolator 2.1.0: built on sd88me's fixed wrapper ([mpc-vst-plugins#499](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins/discussions/499)).
